notes: Named at [0048] on line 640 and [0049] on line 642, in both cases inside the phrase "Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione". Role other because this section is field-use guidance and no chemical step is performed; is_section_product false, the section applies the substance rather than producing it; commercially_available true, it is the marketed active and no step of this document prepares it. The same molecule as tembotrione, same atoms and same bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is crystal modification I and not a distinct chemical entity. Named at [0048] and [0049] as the substance that is applied, either as such, as its formulations or as use forms prepared from them by further dilution, before or after emergence or worked into the soil before sowing. Role other because this section is field-use guidance and no chemical step is performed on it. The application rate at [0050], between 1 g and 1 kg of active ingredient per hectare of soil surface and preferably between 5 g and 500 g per ha, is a dose per area and not a quantity of this compound in a step, so quantity is left null. The section names no other substance: solutions, suspensions, emulsions, powders, pastes and granules are formulation forms, and Wirkstoff is a role word, not a name.
